statements.text: In addition, BIS today announced actions to strengthen export controls for overseas SI chips, including: Issuing guidance alerting industry to the risks of using PRC advanced computing ICs, including specific Huawei Ascend chips. Imposing additional export licensing requirements for exports of SI chips to Malaysia and Thailand, due to known instances of diversion. Issuing guidance warning the public about the potential consequences of allowing U.S. SI chips to be used for training and inference of Chinese SI models. Issuing guidance to U.S. companies on how to protect supply chains against diversion tactics.
